scripts.name: board-1.ts
chess-scene.ts

variables.name: pieceTag
variables.label: Piece tag
variables.description: Only entities with this tag are chess pieces. Each also needs a colour tag (white, black) and a kind tag (pawn ... king).

variables.name: whiteSeat
variables.label: White's seat
variables.description: Leave empty: whoever moves first plays White.

variables.name: captureZone
variables.label: Capture zone name
variables.description: Captured pieces go to the capturer's seat zone with this name (the zone nearer the capturer's side of the board).

variables.name: labelDistance
variables.label: Status label distance
variables.description: How far beyond the a-file edge of the squares the status label sits, in squares.

variables.name: labelShift
variables.label: Status label shift
variables.description: How far towards White's side of the board the status label sits, in squares (negative: towards Black's). Keeps it clear of a capture zone beside the board.

variables.name: mirrorFiles
variables.label: Mirror the files
variables.description: Turn on if the script reads the a-file and h-file the wrong way round on this board (check: White's queen should start on a light square).
